semantics: Expose the collection as an aria-labelled group.
Product-specific content remains outside the shared shell.
visual_contract: Expanded header is yellow by default; existing Slingshot theme overrides it to dark with white text.
Headers and panels retain rounded corners.
accessibility: Enter and Space must toggle disclosure.
constraints: Do not duplicate shell CSS in a consumer.
Do not change existing consumer default-open states without explicit approval.
contentHtml is trusted authored HTML only; this component does not sanitize input.
Item IDs must be unique; defaultOpen is read on mount. Prefer content over contentHtml; HTML wins when both are supplied.
verification: Verify expected decision count and default-open count.
Verify beige closed, yellow open, and white body computed styles.
Verify no nested scrolling or iframe.
Run TypeScript and design-system registry validation.
responsive: Check 1440px, 768px, and 390px; no document overflow. Consumer-specific layout remains local.
use_when: A case study presents consequential product decisions or trade-offs
The content has a stable title plus expandable evidence
do_not_use_when: The content is simple static prose
Nested scrolling or iframe content is required
The interaction is not semantically a disclosure
